name: interview-architect
description: A full-stack, free-to-host system-design interview practice platform.

scripts.dev: npm run db:migrate:local && concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace @interview-architect/web" "npm run dev --workspace @interview-architect/api"
scripts.build: npm run validate --workspace @interview-architect/content && npm run build --workspace @interview-architect/web && npm run typecheck --workspace @interview-architect/api
